title: If I lost everything and had to start day trading from zero, these are the 3 apps I’d use first
author: TradeCoach_
selftext:
If I lost all my money and had to learn day trading from zero, I’d keep it simple and start with these 3 apps:

1. TradingView    
Clean charts, indicators, and a great way to actually learn price action instead of guessing.

2. Webull    
Easy for beginners, simple order placement, and a solid app to practice actually executing trades.

3. Trade Coach    
This is the one I’d use to stay disciplined. Most traders don’t fail because they can’t find setups — they fail because they break their own rules. Trade Coach helps analyze your trades, spot your habits, and keep emotions out of the process.  
I think beginners overcomplicate trading way too fast.  

You don’t need 20 tools. You need:  
•	good charts  
•	a clean broker  
•	something that keeps you disciplined
